description: Five user-approved ordered P04 candidate tasks, existing Kafka/Java and unchanged golden/reference; no production adoption or real source/account identity.

userStories.title: Define bounded synthetic feature-stream contracts
userStories.description: Approved RLP-B06 bounded P04 local synthetic consumer candidate; current isolated story only.
acceptanceCriteria: Add strict typed plan, delivery, state and snapshot contracts, validators and documented exported API for following stories. Expose a typed fixed-code error. Add ONLY exports["./feature-stream"]="./dist/feature-stream.js" to the existing package manifest; all other fields identical.

Delivery binds synthetic event namespace/payment/revision/content plus Kafka topic/partition0/offset. Strict integers, exact two-place unsigned amounts/reversed amounts, real UTC calendar timestamps, explicit lifecycle and invented sender/receiver. Reject unknown fields/coercion/unsafe/nonfinite numbers/ambiguous keys and real provenance.

Plan binds version/run/namespace/topic/window/coverage/snapshot queries and finite limits. Namespace/topic must be synthetic and scoped; a checkpoint cannot be reused under changed plan/input identity. Queries retain all required golden target/as_of/currency/evidence/coverage metadata.

State is JSON serializable, bounded and sufficient for identical-offset and same-revision conflict detection, out-of-order higher/lower revision retention, contiguous next offset, as_of snapshots and immutable snapshot evidence. Validators reject malformed/inconsistent/oversized state; never trust caller success/hash without recomputation by later store.

Snapshot includes target/as_of/currency/window/source-position/config provenance and exact count/amount strings or explicit missing/incomplete reason. No inferred account ownership/zero fallback/calibrated risk/activation fields.
Test exact and one-over bounds, invalid shape/encoding/money/time/identity, unavailable states and state/plan mismatch. Contracts typecheck/test and publication guards must pass.

Authorization: user explicitly confirmed เริ่ม RLP-B06 after the five-story proposal. Implement only the current story in its isolated candidate, preserving all prior code/tests/fixtures/dependencies/locks/automation and all logins. No production adoption, source connection, real identity, provider, payment action or deployment.

Scope: one bounded TypeScript Kafka-consumer candidate using the unchanged packages/risk/test/fixtures/feature-streams/golden.json and existing offline risk reference. Do not turn the P03 specimens CDC table into canonical payments. All entities are invented synthetic_declared identity only. No Flink/Streams/cache/dependency installation, HTTP endpoint, database migration or Python-engine rewrite.

Finite experimental limits: golden input <=32 deliveries/8 snapshots/32768 bytes; single Kafka partition; complete run captures <=2000 records and <=2MiB; serialized consumer checkpoint <=1MiB and finite revision/offset maps. Reject overflow, gaps, corruption and unsupported state without truncation. Native host trial <=180s including reserved teardown, owned runtime <=2GiB, >=6GiB free before startup, existing fixed JVM heaps and loopback only. These are fixture bounds, not SLO/capacity claims.

Use existing TS golden semantics exactly: same-currency outgoing latest available revision in (target.occurred_at-3600s,target.occurred_at], exact decimal/BigInt money, full/partial reversal, missing/incomplete coverage unavailable instead of0. Snapshot as_of/coverage/evidence are explicitly supplied synthetic metadata; never infer historical availability from Kafka arrival/wall clock. Retain future revisions for eligible later as_of, and preserve previously frozen evidence. Not an online event-time/watermark/TTL-adoption proof.

Meaningful new tests must work both from repo root and package cwd using import.meta.url. Existing golden corpus/reference/tests remain unchanged; independent expected values and reference comparisons must detect broken arithmetic/order/offset/restore. Runtime/IO/invalid CLI tests must not start native services. Do not relax existing assertions or install dependencies.

Coding-agent sandbox may run scoped unit/subprocess checks and required builds/typechecks available there. Native Java/Kafka/binding and legacy DB integration suites are parent-host only. A host-generated native acceptance after final source checks/promotion is mandatory; fake/test receipts or ready_for_verification never establish native success.

Run the fixed checkGroup commands and publication/source/plan/Git guards through the unchanged trusted host verifier. No lint command exists: never invent lint PASS. Tests and full host gates are recorded only after actual exit0. Public checksum metadata must use grouped lossless hex as existing pins; never weaken scanner/allowlist/locks. Keep production_ready=false.

userStories.title: Implement bounded incremental feature reducer and reference parity
userStories.description: Approved RLP-B06 bounded P04 local synthetic consumer candidate; current isolated story only.
acceptanceCriteria: Use US-601 contracts to implement an inert, deterministic, IO-free reducer: initialize/restore state, apply bounded positioned delivery, and materialize typed snapshots. Export only by appending export * from ./feature-stream.js to risk index; preserve its entire old prefix.

Require contiguous new offsets beginning0, acknowledge identical replayed offsets without applying twice, reject changed content at an existing offset and gaps. Same namespace/payment/revision with changed payload conflicts; identical revision at a new offset advances source position once without double contribution.

Retain bounded revisions and select the highest revision available at each supplied as_of even when deliveries arrive out of order. Compute current golden one-hour same-sender/same-currency count and exact net amount, including late correction, partial/full reversal and fixed endpoints. Never apply a future correction to an earlier frozen snapshot.

Enforce finite maps/state/snapshot limits and typed unavailable when evidence/coverage is missing. No silently dropped records, inferred safe zero, approximate money, cross-namespace/currency leakage or guessed real identities.

Tests independently assert every frozen golden snapshot using unchanged corpus and existing reference calculator. Include prefix/restart state roundtrip, same/changed duplicate, gaps, old-after-new revision, future as_of, reversal, cross-scope, tampered state, caps and failed-apply input immutability.

Risk typecheck/test and publication/source guards pass; tests must prove incremental state handling rather than simply returning stored expected fixture values or delegating all reducer behavior to the existing whole-corpus calculator.

userStories.title: Persist bounded consumer checkpoints with atomic recovery
userStories.description: Approved RLP-B06 bounded P04 local synthetic consumer candidate; current isolated story only.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement an inert worker adapter around the reducer with a documented API for US-604: new owned private state directory, open/restore, consume positioned deliveries, materialize snapshots, close, and receipt. No arbitrary code/config loading, network, database, provider or native binary work in this adapter.

Checkpoint binds current plan/config/input identity, reducer state, source cursor, frozen snapshots and recomputed content hashes. Validate every restored field and bounded bytes before use. Exact retry reuses committed evidence; changed config/content/corruption/missing committed files stops without overwriting evidence.

One cooperating writer with atomic exclusive ownership and no stale-PID takeover. Refuse concurrent writer/unowned existing state, symlink/FIFO/hard-link/traversal or unsafe ancestors. Cleanup touches positively owned live state only. Unresolved ownership remains blocked; no process-name killing or arbitrary existing output overwrite.

Publish checkpoint effects and next-offset together via bounded private staged file, fsync and atomic replacement/directory fsync. ACK only after durable commit. Fault before publication leaves previous committed state usable; fault after publication is recoverable by validated replay. No skipped predecessor, duplicate totals or false complete marker. Document filesystem-local limits and unresolved crash-owner behavior honestly.

Use controlled fault injection only as trusted unit seam, never a CLI fake/receipt mode. Test real workspace filesystem publication/restore, exact replay, corruption, changed plan, private modes/links/concurrent writer, before/after commit failures, failed-operation input/state immutability and byte/map limits.
All worker typecheck/tests and unchanged publication/source guards pass through parent host fixtures. Coding agent runs available current tests/build only and lists host-only/native gates pending.

userStories.title: Exercise actual Kafka golden streams against the consumer
userStories.description: Approved RLP-B06 bounded P04 local synthetic consumer candidate; current isolated story only.
acceptanceCriteria: Add import-safe explicit host runner using existing unchanged cdc-runtime.mjs createRuntime/verifyRuntime/ownedProcessHandles/childEnvironment, exact pinned Kafka/Java and inventoried client jars. No download/install/runtime/pin changes, new npm package, shell execution, existing broker, MariaDB, Connect, cache or real data.

Create one private owned broker/topic and actual finite producer/reader against loopback (fixed Java source-file helper may use pinned existing Kafka clients). Send the unchanged golden events with deterministic synthetic positioned envelopes; capture actual partition/offset/value and feed the real compiled US-603 consumer. All text/child outputs privately bounded; no payload/credential diagnostic in console/errors.

Use new project .local evidence and short owned /private/tmp/lmps-feature-* helper scratch if required; keep all existing CDC supervisors/pins/tests unchanged. Strict CLI has one explicit run/output shape, rejects unknown flags/existing destination/unsafe paths and performs no native work on import or invalid arguments.

Prove initial snapshots match every fixed golden expected count/amount/unavailable reason and existing independent reference. Controlled broker stop/restart and consumer close/reopen preserve topic position/checkpoint; actual reread/replay yields identical snapshots/durable prefix with no extra effects. Observe quiet endOffsets so missing/extra/gap records cannot be silently truncated as success.

Observe all common finite resource bounds and reserved teardown. Stop every owned helper/broker child on all paths, await close, expose ownership for final acceptance and retain fixed-code failure evidence. No retry loop, automatic stale-owner recovery, global kill or deletion of unknown state. Do not claim SIGKILL/TTL/lateness admission/HA/online production correctness unless actually proved.

Return only independently checkable count/hash/version/position/cleanup receipts from the actual run; never publish final acceptance here. Unit tests use trusted lifecycle/IO seams only and cover inert import/CLI/errors/bounds/extra capture/conflicts/native failure cleanup. Parent runs actual native trial after final source checks; fake fixtures are not native evidence.

userStories.description: Approved RLP-B06 bounded P04 local synthetic consumer candidate; current isolated story only.
acceptanceCriteria: Add import-safe explicit host acceptance CLI invoking the actual default US-604 native runner. No receipt-file input, fake mode, runtime/runner/environment injection or caller-supplied success. Strict output under project .local, new private destination, generic redacted nonzero failure.

Bind before/after source hashes for current contracts/reducer/worker/supervisor/runner/acceptance/golden/pins, plus actual compiled JS used; verify runtime independently before/after. Compare actual emitted golden snapshots to independent fixed expected outputs/reference and validate durable position/restart/replay counts/hashes. No generated/self-reported expected values may replace checks.

Verify private persisted pipeline/checkpoint receipt matches current invocation and all owned process handles are empty after successful teardown. Finite elapsed/bytes/state/storage/resource limits are mandatory. Publish final acceptance.json exclusively/atomically only after all checks, with count/hash-only proof, production_ready=false and explicit remaining phase/adoption/identity/operations gates.

Add meaningful inert-import/invalid CLI/native failure/forged receipt/provenance mismatch/immutable atomic publication tests using test-process substitutes only. Unit proof never counts as actual native success. New tests are cwd-independent and existing tests/fixtures/automation/package locks remain unchanged.

Document commands/run/status/stop/recovery, exact versions/limits, snapshot semantics, owned cleanup, local checkpoint guarantees and limitations. Append honest implementation handoff to current.md preserving its full current prefix. Coding handoff lists full host/native gates pending; trusted verifier appends only actual standard check results.

Run fixed full host automation/typecheck/test/build/frozen offline verify:fresh/publication guards, guarded promotion and durable receipts for all five tasks. Parent must then execute node apps/risk-workers/scripts/feature-stream-acceptance.mjs --output <new-project-private-directory> on final promoted source and independently verify current hashes, actual result and zero remaining owned processes before reporting success. Stop queue after US-605.
